Harper - Marketing: Quick kick: launching HackLab Mini next week. Two small assets: (1) 'Refapp Sprint' tutorial + repo, (2) 'Bench Lights' short bench walk. Need blog blurb, webinar plan, email drip, and inbound routing. Can we land this by Thu?
Diego - DevRel: I can own the repo. Goal: `docker run` demo, README + a 20m guided lab. Will add a tiny repro script for bench runs.
Sofia - Growth: A/B subjects: 'Ship a refapp in 30m' vs 'Watch a live cost run'. CTA variants: 'Get the tutorial' / 'Join live'. Will test across two segments.
Cal - Product: Bench note: include model variant and two hardware points (A100 vs T4) and a short metrics table: tokens/sec, median p99, tokens per $. Add reproducible config.
Zane - Growth Ops: Routing plan: refapp -> self-serve funnel + repo link; bench -> nurture + tag bench_interest. Hidden fields: utm_campaign=hacklab_mini, promo=mini-hack. If company_size>50 -> notify SE channel.
lifecycle-bot: Reminder scheduled: review in 36h.
Harper - Marketing: Owners + deadlines: Diego -> repo (48h), Sofia -> email variants + social (36h), Zane -> routing + tracking (24h), Cal -> bench artifacts + quote (48h), Harper -> blog draft + landing (36h). I'll open GH issues and calendar. Thanks :rocket:
